Saudi Arabia's economic challenges and global role debated

Saudi Arabia faces accusations of hindering progress at COP climate talks, with its economic reliance on oil complicating diversification efforts under Vision 2030. The nation's substantial wealth fund, valued at $1 trillion, is reportedly experiencing an "identity crisis." Additionally, past military defeats are cited as a factor deterring allies from intervening in Yemen.
